notes.title: VR Version Released!!! 🥳
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Car Detailing Simulator VR 👓 is out on Steam![/b][/h1]

[h3]Conduct all the amazing detailing transformations in the immersive VR environment. 🤯[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2527890/Car_Detailing_Simulator_VR/

[h3]Already have a [b]Car Detailing Simulator on Steam? 👀[/b] Get an extra [b]10% off[/b] when you buy the [b]VR version in a bundle![/b] 👇[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43528/Detailing_in_Virtual_Reality/

[previewyoutube=MW4S8zu30zo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Enjoy working on cars and complete the tasks with style! 🏎️[/h3]

[b][u]Key Features of the Virtual Reality Adventure 👓[/u][/b]

*Three types of treatments (basic, internal, and external)
*Each tool has some form of ammunition for its operation
*Various degrees of dirtiness
*A set of tools and accessories to work with
*Modern garage equipped with a lift, rack, etc.
*Take on new orders and earn money
*Ten old-school classic and modern cars to work on

[h2][b]The brand new VR detailing adventure is right here! PLAY NOW! 🔥[/b][/h2]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/j4ySVzdCYQ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/2d756892db2e4818983f27bd09f3c054250ffaf9.png[/img][/url] 

See you around,
CDS VR Team

notes.title: VR Version Release Date Set!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Attention Detailers! 📣[/b][/h1]

[h3]We are excited to announce that the [b]VR version 🕶️[/b] of the [b]Car Detailing Simulator[/b] is launching on [b]September 26, 2024, at 3:00 PM CEST[/b]! 🥳[/h3]

[h3][b]Don't miss the premiere and add it to your Wishlist! ✅ 👇[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2527890/Car_Detailing_Simulator_VR/

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2527890/Car_Detailing_Simulator_VR/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/11eb80a02d6f47fee6f3f7d1b10d0cf185c18225.png[/img][/url]

Get ready to dive into the immersive car detailing world and experience the satisfaction of bringing life back to every car you touch. Mark your calendars and prepare for the ultimate VR detailing experience on September 26, 2024, at 3:00 PM CEST!
